siteDescription: Legitimate paid-writing opportunities, practical writing guides, and BRYME's firsthand verification record.

adsense.note: Advertising is disabled during the quality rebuild. Set caId to a real ca-pub-... ID and review consent/privacy before enabling. Ads must never resemble job cards or application buttons.

newsletter.note: mode 'mailto' = prefilled subscribe email to the mailbox (bootstrap). mode 'form' = endpoint must be the provider's form POST URL (Buttondown/MailerLite/ListMonk embeds work as-is with input name=email).

follow.note: Public channel URLs. A link renders only when set.

affiliate.note: No affiliate links exist yet. Flip enabled=true only after provider accounts are live AND docs/revenue-rails.md placement rules have been applied. The disclosure note renders automatically on guides tagged 'affiliate: true' in front matter.
